shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/totalUsageContract.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"totalUsageContract|aggregatedUsage|UsageMetadata|describe\\(\" src/types src/orchestration -g '*.test.ts' | head -120 && sed -n '1,220p' layers.yaml 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"whole-turn|totalUsageContract|exposes the hook usage|TOTAL_USAGE_SCOPE\" specs src CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,220p' src/index.ts && rg -n \"export (type )?.*OrchestratorHooks|interface OrchestratorHooks|type OrchestratorHooks\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/totalUsageContract.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/totalUsageContract.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' jest.config.js && rg -n \"from '../index|from '../../index|TOTAL_USAGE_SCOPE\" src -g '*.test.ts' && rg -n \"testMatch|transform\" package.json jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/totalUsageContract.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/transport/totalUsageContract.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/totalUsageContract.test.ts src/transport/totalUsageContract.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/totalUsageContract.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/totalUsageContract.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/totalUsageContract.test.ts src/totalUsageContract.test.ts && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m "Fix total usage contract test lint" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
